offline.app: You're offline. Showing what's saved on this phone.
offline.signIn: You're offline. Connect to the internet to sign in.

welcome.page1Body: See your profile, your leads and how customers find you, wherever you are.
welcome.page2Body: Send your profile on WhatsApp, or show your QR code to anyone nearby.
welcome.page3Title: Set up cards by tapping them
welcome.page3Body: Hold a TapTap card to your phone to point it at your profile.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Sign in with the email you use for TapTap.
signIn.expired: You were signed out. Sign in again to carry on.
signIn.emailInvalid: Enter your email address, like name@business.co.ke.
signIn.notConfigured: This build is missing its server settings, so it can't sign in.

code.title: Enter code
code.heading: Check your email
code.label: {{length}}-digit code
code.resendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
code.resent: New code sent. Use the latest one.
code.spam: It can take a minute to arrive. Check spam if you don't see it.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.heading: Reset your password
forgot.intro: We'll email you a code, then you choose a new password.
forgot.sentTo: If {{email}} has a TapTap account, we've sent it a {{length}}-digit code.
forgot.codeAccepted: Code accepted. Now choose your new password.

errors.offline: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.wrongPassword: That email and password don't match. Try again, or reset your password.
errors.noAccount: We couldn't find a TapTap account for that email.
errors.wrongCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Check your latest email, or send a new code.
errors.emailWait: We've just emailed you. Wait a minute before asking for another code.
errors.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.notConfirmed: Confirm your email first, using the link we sent when you signed up.
errors.weakPassword: Choose a stronger password: longer, and harder to guess.
errors.samePassword: That's your current password. Choose a new one.
errors.blocked: This account can't sign in. Contact Hornbill support.
errors.invalidEmail: That email address doesn't look right.

account.signOutBody: You'll need your email to sign back in. Nothing is deleted, and you stay signed in on the website.

foundation.typeSample: Tap to connect with your customers.
foundation.sentryTest: Send a test error to Sentry

nfcCheck.intro: Hold a TapTap card to your phone to read the link on its chip. Nothing is sent anywhere.
nfcCheck.scanning: Hold the card near the phone…
nfcCheck.iosAlert: Hold your TapTap card near the top of your iPhone
nfcCheck.resultEmpty: This tag has no link on it
